family_a.rule: stream = splitmix64(seed); per draw z1, z2, z3 = next three outputs; k = (z2 >> 32) % 60 - 29; sign = bit 63 of z3; bits = (sign << 63) | ((k + 1023) << 52) | (z1 & (2^52 - 1)); x = the double with those bits (no arithmetic); skip the draw when |x| > 1e9

family_b.rule: stream = splitmix64(seed XOR 0x5555555555555555); d = 1 + (z1 >> 20) % 17; n = z2 % 10^d; frac = (z3 >> 24) % (d + 1); text = decimal text of n; when frac > 0 left-pad to frac + 1 digits and put the point before the last frac digits; a leading minus when bit 63 of z3 is set; the verdict of the codec decides (range / precision) which texts are valid
